hint.text: Materials that come from the natural world are called natural materials. Other materials that are produced artificially using chemicals are known as synthetic materials.

instruction.text: Drag each material to the correct group.
What material is this chair made of?

feedback.end: Trees are mostly made up of wood. To obtain wood, trees are chopped down and taken away to be processed.

instruction.text: What material is this dog bowl made of?

feedback.end: Metals are a group of many different materials that are mostly found as traces in rock. By heating the rock, we can remove the valuable metal it contains.

instruction.text: What material are these bottles made of?

feedback.end: Glass is made by heating sand or rocks that contain quartz to a very high temperature. The individual grains melt together and leave a hard solid when they cool.

instruction.text: What material is this envelope made of?

feedback.end: Paper is manufactured using plant fibres, usually from wood. The fibres are mixed into a pulp and the water is pressed out, leaving a dry, flat sheet. Fibres are small, thin pieces that make up a material. They look a bit like short sections of thread.

instruction.text: What material is this toy boat made of?

feedback.end: Synthetics are a group of different materials that are often also described as plastics. They are almost all made using crude oil.
